SODA 110N: SoDA 110N introduces students to the landscape of artificial intelligence (AI) and digital technology through the lens of human-generated data and societal applications.
SODA 197: Formal courses offered infrequently to explore, in depth, a subject that may be topical or of special interest.
SODA 308: This course engages students in the study and use of research design tools for the analysis of "big data.
SODA 314: This course offers advanced, applied training in the use and understanding of artificial intelligence technologies and their applications to large-scale, human-generated information.
SODA 496: Creative projects, including research and design, which are supervised on an individual basis and which fall outside the scope of formal courses.
SODA 497: Formal courses offered infrequently to explore, in depth, a comparatively narrow subject which may be topical or of special interest.
